title: Shift notes: candidate triage & scheduling (Izzy)
body:
Morning shift — quick brain dump and checklist

6:30am — first pass inbox (Izzy)
- unread candidate replies: 5 (priority A: 2, B: 3)
- interview declines: 1 (need to reschedule panel)
- calendar conflicts flagged by hiring manager: 2

Priorities for today
1) Confirm times for 3 PM panel (K. Alvarez) — need responses from hiring mgr + engineering lead by 10:30am
2) Follow up with no-reply candidates >48h: send reminder template A
3) Greenhouse updates: move 4 candidates to "Phone Screen" stage, add notes for recruiter review
4) Reschedule candidate who requested timezone change (Europe -> PST) — propose 10am PST or 6pm PST
5) Finalize interviewer backup list for Friday on-call window

Quick templates (copy/paste)
- Reminder template A (no reply >48h):
  Subject: Quick follow-up on your interview availability
  Hi [Candidate],
  Hope you're well — checking in to see if you had a chance to pick a slot for the phone screen. If I don't hear back by EOD tomorrow I'll open the slot to other candidates. If you'd still like to interview, reply with 3 times that work for you.
  Thanks,
  Izzy

- Reschedule due to timezone change (candidate):
  Hi [Candidate],
  Thanks for flagging your timezone. I can move your phone screen to [NEW-TIME]. Would 10:00 AM PST or 6:00 PM PST work for you? If neither works, share 3 times that do.
  Best,
  Izzy

Notes on specific candidates (triage)
- A. Moreno (SWE-1) — declined offer call last week, asked for additional context on interview format. Action: slack hiring mgr (Jordan) to confirm panel composition and resend panel invite with names + Slack handles. Due: 11:00am
- R. Singh (Data Eng) — no reply to calendar invite; candidate timezone IST. Action: send reminder template A + propose alternate windows. Mark as "watch" in Greenhouse so recruiter knows to prioritize.
- C. Patel (SWE-2) — needs accommodation for earlier slot due to travel. Action: hold 9:30am slot, confirm interviewer availability (Maya). If unavailable, offer 4/8 6:30pm slot.
- Interviewer X (Eng lead) — flagged two conflicts for Friday: 10:00 and 2:00. Action: build backup interviewer list and confirm backups by EOD.

Calendar & timeblocks (my shift)
- 8:30–9:15 AM: email cleanup + GH stage updates
- 9:15–9:45 AM: coordinate with hiring managers (slack messages, ping)
- 10:00–11:00 AM: scheduling block — confirm invites/reschedules
- 1:00–1:30 PM: phone screens (as backup interviewer)
- 3:00–4:00 PM: panel scheduling + final checks for Friday
- 4:30–5:00 PM: handoff notes to evening shift (if any)

Escalation rules (to Talent Lead / Hiring Manager)
- No candidate reply after two reminders (72h) -> escalate to recruiter assigned (Maya) to determine next steps
- Candidate asks for compensation/offer timeline before phone screen -> escalate to hiring manager for pre-screen guidance
- Multiple interviewer cancellations (2+) for same candidate -> open a staffing ticket with recruiting ops / SRE to prioritize reschedule windows

Operational reminders & checkboxes
- [ ] Attach candidate CV to calendar invite (some folks forget)
- [ ] Add Slack handles to panel invites (reduces confusion)
- [ ] Update Greenhouse with "candidate confirmed" once we get affirmative reply
- [ ] Note in candidate profile if they mentioned other active processes (clientside)

Things I want to try (notes to self)
- Two-step invite: hold tentative slot for candidate while getting interviewer confirmation (reduces back-and-forth)
- Use a short Loom clip to explain panel format for candidates — see if that reduces no-shows
- Add "question bank" to panel invite so interviewers have suggested prompts (helps new interviewers)

Unresolved / questions
- Can we add a "preferred contact time" field to the GH application form? (ask product-ops)
- Are we allowed to offer 30-minute virtual whiteboarding for some senior roles? (check policy)

End-of-shift handoff (to evening coordinator)
- Summary: 7 candidates pending replies, 2 reschedules in flight, 1 panel confirmed (3 PM).
- Actions for evening: continue reminders cycle, monitor responses, finalize Friday backup list if any new conflicts arise.
- Tag any urgent follow-ups in SLACK channel #recruiting-coord with prefix [URGENT] and candidate initials.

Random quick notes
- Candidate timezone conversions cheat-sheet saved in my Drive -> link CONF-people-ops/schedules
- Use "Reschedule: candidate name" as calendar subject line so it's searchable

---
Timestamp: 2026-04-06 08:05 (local)
Last quick thought: add a 10-min buffer between back-to-back phone screens in GH booking flow — fewer overruns.
